summary: Clearway arterial kerb with no parked cars; nowhere to pull out of traffic.
reasons: Homes close on the south side

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit just behind the south footpath; fully exposed to the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane carries moving traffic and a bus stop; no pull-off.
drivers.convention: Clearway MON-SAT 7am-7pm tow away and a bus zone; nobody parks here.
